arithmetic.complexity: For n-bit modulus: addition O(n) gates/work, multiplication O(n^2), exponent inversion O(n^3); reverse cleanup doubles compute cost.
arithmetic.test_scope: Exhaustive input domains through 10 input bits, seeded arbitrary output per input and explicit boundaries; wider instances sampled.

operator.scope: Actually trained finite time-conditioned heat operator. Shared coefficients preserve stochasticity, CPTP lift and covering intertwining. Error measured against exact heat and same-degree analytic Poisson baseline; not a quantum advantage or continuum interacting-field solution.

calibration.scope: Precision refinement of the conditional joint-phase null with refreshed normalization. Binomial intervals quantify simulation uncertainty conditional on this null, observed score and reference, not foreground/instrument misspecification or a probability for CCC.
